description: Behavioral evals for the HoloHub imaging_ai_segmentator wrapper. Tests native HoloHub CLI use, container prerequisites, and DICOM SEG/NIfTI evidence reporting.

evals.prompt: Run the HoloHub imaging_ai_segmentator app on a CT DICOM series at /data/ct_series using Medical AI Skills wrapper.
evals.expected_output: The agent sets HOLOHUB_ROOT and HOLOHUB_RUN_MODE=container, then runs eval_engine.run for skills/holohub-imaging-ai-segmentator with the DICOM series as fixture and an explicit out dir.
assertions: the command uses skills/holohub-imaging-ai-segmentator through the documented wrapper surface
the command sets or checks HOLOHUB_ROOT
the command includes --fixture with the user DICOM series path
the agent states the HoloHub smoke data is not clinical validation

baseline_methodology.with_skill_setup: Agent has HoloHub setup requirements and evidence outputs from SKILL.md.
baseline_methodology.without_skill_setup: Agent may try to reimplement DICOM-to-MONAI-to-SEG plumbing or skip container prerequisites.
baseline_methodology.expected_delta: with_skill: native HoloHub CLI path and evidence pack. without_skill: higher setup drift and unverifiable artifacts.
